title: Elastic Security integration with Google Distributed Cloud: Closing the velocity gap in air-gapped environments
summary: As AI-powered threats grow more complex, traditional security operations struggle to keep pace. Google Distributed Cloud AI SecOps, powered by Elastic, brings AI-driven detection, investigation, and response to fully air-gapped environments.

title: Making data work across boundaries: The next challenge for policing
summary: Police reform depends on making data work across force boundaries. Connecting data where it lives gives policing national reach, keeps local accountability, and makes AI cheaper and faster to scale.
